issuing_body: European Commission / AI Office (Working Group 1, Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI Models)
covered_actors: providers of AI systems integrating general-purpose AI models
compliance_deadlines: Information must be provided to downstream providers within 14 days of receiving a request, save for exceptional circumstances
Model documentation must be retained for 10 years after the model has been placed on the market
implementation_notes: This is a voluntary Code of Practice under Article 53 AI Act. Adherence does not constitute conclusive evidence of compliance with AI Act obligations. Open-source model providers are exempt from Measures 1.1-1.3 unless the model poses systemic risk. Confidentiality protections apply per Article 78 AI Act. A fillable Model Documentation Form is provided as a compliance tool.
